messages:
deploy-bot: Heads up — scheduled canary deploy 'release/2026-03-20-14' to prod-us in 10m. Image: gh/ri/redwood-inference@v1.4.3
maya: saw deploy bot. Which services are in the canary?
deploy-bot: Canary targets: inference-runtime, router, metrics-sidecar (10% traffic)
sam: @maya @oliver FYI incident INC-2026-45 still showing request throttling in eu. prod-us looks nominal but I'd prefer a short hold.
maya: let's hold for now until we confirm incident impact. Can we pin the release and reschedule canary?
oliver: +1 hold. Routing changes are risky while infra is flaky.
riyah: oncall (sam) says mitigation is in progress but not fully verified — recommend waiting 20–30m.
sam: putting an incident hold on the release now: `/release hold release/2026-03-20-14 reason="INC-2026-45"`
deploy-bot: Release hold applied by sam. Status: HELD. Automated canary canceled.
maya: please pin image to avoid accidental retries: `gh/ri/redwood-inference@v1.4.3` -> pin tag `pinned/2026-03-20-14`
oliver: runbook snippet to pin: 
```
# pin release to avoid auto-retries
deployctl pin --release release/2026-03-20-14 --tag pinned/2026-03-20-14
```
riyah: added a line to the release notes draft: "Hold due to INC-2026-45; canary postponed." Will update the PR shortly.
sam: proposing reschedule window +3h (17:30 UTC) to give SRE time; objections?
maya: fine by me. On retry, let's lower initial canary to 5% and ramp slower.
oliver: agreed: 5% -> 20% over 30m. Safer.
deploy-bot: Noted. Creating reschedule ticket: https://tickets/redwood/RELEASE-2482 and will set canary traffic plan to 5% initial on retry.
incident-bot: INC-2026-45 status: investigating -> mitigation applied, monitoring.
sam: updated changelog: `changelog/release-2026-03-20.md` with hold note and reschedule plan.
maya: I'll re-announce 15m before the new window or earlier if incident clears.
riyah: I'll update the customer-facing status template if cross-region impacts persist.
sam: thanks all. If incident clears early we'll re-evaluate and unhold.
oliver: :thumbsup:
